title: [3.2.0.1] AAPSClient crash because of VirtualPump driver on NS sync
symptom: AAPSClient crashes on both user's and wife's phones after about a day of working. Logs show pump driver error forcing app to exit. The crash occurs when receiving a devicestatus record from Nightscout.
cause: A broken devicestatus record added to the devicestatus collection forces both AAPS and AAPSClient to crash on receiving it from NS. The record has default values in all fields, causing a JSON parsing error: Expected BEGIN_OBJECT but was STRING at path $[26].openaps.
fix: The fix is a commit referenced by MilosKozak: https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/4dde47bc44562d5082516ca65296b92d318b7773. The thread does not describe the exact change, but it is the resolution.
evidence_quote: ok, got it - somehow added broken record to `devicestatus` collection - this forces both aaps/aapsclient to crash on receiving it from NS
